rules.description: assets: allow only GET and HEAD on /a/, /f/, / and /ip
rules.expression: http.host eq "assets.kanthorlabs.com" and (not http.request.method in {"GET" "HEAD"} or not (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/a/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/f/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/" or http.request.uri.path eq "/ip"))
